title: OpenTelemetry & Tempo
description: Grafana.com 23242 rev 1, adapted for this lab: Alloy OTLP, spanmetrics/servicegraph connectors, Tempo 3.1 live store and filesystem storage. Optional Memcached, tail-sampling, load-balancer and Tempo metrics-generator sections are replaced by real deployed pipeline signals. Absent event counters can mean no events; no data is not proof of health. Span calls count spans, not unique user requests.
